choose.when: and e.exam_status != '마감' and e.exam_end > systimestamp and ( e.exam_status = '작성중' or e.exam_start > systimestamp )
and e.exam_status = '공개' and e.exam_start <= systimestamp and e.exam_end > systimestamp

sql.where:
and sc.student_no = #{studentNo}
and sc.student_course_status = '수강중'
and e.exam_status in ('공개', '마감')
and e.course_no = #{courseNo}
and e.exam_title like '%' || #{examTitle} || '%'
and e.exam_status = '공개' and systimestamp < e.exam_start and e.exam_end > systimestamp
and e.exam_status = '공개' and e.exam_start <= systimestamp and e.exam_end > systimestamp
and ( e.exam_status = '마감' or e.exam_end <= systimestamp )
and att.attempt_no is null
and att.attempt_no is not null and att.attempt_submit is null
and att.attempt_submit is not null

mapper.insert: insert into exam ( exam_no, course_no, employee_no, exam_title, exam_info, exam_start, exam_end, exam_limit, exam_status, exam_wtime ) values ( #{examNo}, #{courseNo}, #{employeeNo}, #{examTitle}, #{examInfo}, #{examStart}, #{examEnd}, #{examLimit}, #{examStatus}, systimestamp )
mapper.select: select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.employee_no, a.account_name, e.exam_title, e.exam_info, e.exam_start, e.exam_end, e.exam_limit, e.exam_status, e.exam_wtime from exam e join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no join employee emp on e.employee_no = emp.employee_no join account a on emp.account_no = a.account_no where e.exam_no = #{examNo}

select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.exam_title, e.exam_info, e.exam_start, e.exam_end, e.exam_limit, e.exam_status, ( select count(*) from question q where q.exam_no = e.exam_no ) as question_count, ( select nvl(sum(q.question_score), 0) from question q where q.exam_no = e.exam_no ) as total_score, at.attempt_no, at.attempt_status, at.attempt_start, at.attempt_submit, at.attempt_score from exam e join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no left join attempt at on e.exam_no = at.exam_no and at.student_no = #{studentNo} where e.exam_no = #{examNo} and e.exam_status in ('공개', '마감') and exists ( select 1 from student_course sc where sc.course_no = e.course_no and sc.student_no = #{studentNo} )

select * from ( select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.employee_no, a.account_name, e.exam_title, e.exam_start, e.exam_end, e.exam_limit, e.exam_status, e.exam_wtime from exam e join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no join employee emp on e.employee_no = emp.employee_no join account a on emp.account_no = a.account_no where e.course_no = #{courseNo} order by e.exam_wtime desc, e.exam_no desc ) where ROWNUM <= 5

select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.exam_title, e.exam_start, e.exam_end, e.exam_limit, e.exam_status,
at.attempt_no, at.attempt_status, at.attempt_submit, at.attempt_score
from exam e
join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no
join student_course cs on e.course_no = cs.course_no
left join attempt at on e.exam_no = at.exam_no and at.student_no = cs.student_no
where cs.student_no = #{studentNo} and cs.student_course_status = '수강중' and e.exam_status in ('공개', '마감')
order by e.exam_start desc

select * from ( select inner_table.*, ROWNUM rn from ( select e.exam_no, e.course_no, c.course_title, e.employee_no, a.account_name, e.exam_title, e.exam_start, e.exam_end, e.exam_limit, e.exam_status,
case when e.exam_status = '마감' or systimestamp >= e.exam_end then '종료'
when e.exam_status = '작성중' or e.exam_start > systimestamp then '예정'
else '응시가능' end as exam_phase,
e.exam_wtime
from exam e
join course c on e.course_no = c.course_no
join employee emp on e.employee_no = emp.employee_no
join account a on emp.account_no = a.account_no
order by e.exam_no desc
) inner_table
where ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) where rn >= #{beginRow}
select count(*) from exam e join student_course sc on e.course_no = sc.course_no left join attempt att on e.exam_no = att.exam_no and att.student_no = #{studentNo}
mapper.update: update exam set course_no = #{courseNo}, exam_title = #{examTitle}, exam_info = #{examInfo}, exam_start = #{examStart}, exam_end = #{examEnd}, exam_limit = #{examLimit}, exam_status = #{examStatus} where exam_no = #{examNo}
mapper.select:
select at.attempt_no, sc.student_no, a.account_name as student_name, at.attempt_status, at.attempt_start, at.attempt_submit, at.attempt_score
from exam e
join student_course sc on e.course_no = sc.course_no
join student s on sc.student_no = s.student_no
join account a on s.account_no = a.account_no
left join attempt at on at.exam_no = e.exam_no and at.student_no = sc.student_no
where e.exam_no = #{examNo}
order by sc.student_no asc

select count(sc.student_no) as totalStudentCount, sum( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' then 1 else 0 end ) as submittedCount,
sum( case when at.attempt_status = '응시중' then 1 else 0 end ) as inProgressCount,
sum( case when at.attempt_no is null then 1 else 0 end ) as notAttemptedCount,
round( avg( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' then at.attempt_score end ), 1 ) as averageScore,
max( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' then at.attempt_score end ) as highestScore,
min( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' then at.attempt_score end ) as lowestScore
from exam e
join student_course sc on e.course_no = sc.course_no
left join attempt at on e.exam_no = at.exam_no and sc.student_no = at.student_no
where e.exam_no = #{examNo}
and sc.student_course_status = '수강중'

select q.question_no as questionNo, q.question_order as questionOrder, q.question_content as questionContent,
sum( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' and aa.is_correct = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end ) as correctCount,
sum( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' then 1 else 0 end ) as submittedCount,
case when sum( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' then 1 else 0 end ) = 0 then 0
else round( sum( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' and aa.is_correct = 'Y' then 1 else 0 end ) / sum( case when at.attempt_status = '제출완료' then 1 else 0 end ) * 100, 1 ) end as correctRate
from question q
join exam e on q.exam_no = e.exam_no
join student_course sc on e.course_no = sc.course_no
left join attempt at on e.exam_no = at.exam_no and sc.student_no = at.student_no
left join attempt_answer aa on at.attempt_no = aa.attempt_no and q.question_no = aa.question_no
where q.exam_no = #{examNo}
and sc.student_course_status = '수강중'
group by q.question_no, q.question_order, q.question_content
order by q.question_order asc
